[Y6NGTTC6]: 24 and 304. According to the gSer gling by rGang lo, edited in [Y6NGTTC6]: 100 (dgung lo bcu drug la dka' brag tu dge bshes mchog gi bla ma la dge tshul mdzad nas). Novice ordination in dKa' brag (ID:6480).
[I58Z22ET]: 408-409, n. 42, based on Dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam thar in Si tu Chos kyi 'byung gnas's Karma kam tshang gser 'phreng (tre ka brag ces bya ba'i bka' gdams kyi dgon pas mkhan po mchog gi bla ma (ID:6479) dang | slob dpon seng ge grags (ID:7207) las rab tu byung nas). 
[W4T5ZMUP]:84 [52a2–3] (de nas [dus gsum mkhyen pa] dgung lo bcu drug zhes pa'i tshe | chos 'khor chen po ka brag tu | rngog lo tstsha ba'i slob ma mchog gi bla mas mkhas po dang | chag seng ge grags kyis slob dpon mdzad de rab tu byung nas |).
